Multipurpose Worker: Middle pass (8th) and its equivalent from school duly recognized by the State Government.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://jsv.hp.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag for filling various vacancies in the Pragpur region of Himachal Pradesh on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under this notification?
faq.answer: The available posts include Para Pump Operator, Para Fitter, and Multipurpose Worker, offering a total of 10 vacancies for eligible job seekers in the department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies released under advertisement number NO.EE-JSV-Pragpur-EA-II-Para Staff/2026 for various categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by filling out the prescribed application form and sending it to the designated official address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled-out offline application form to the office of the Executive Engineer, Jal Shakti Division Pragpur is 21-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 45 years of age as specified in the recruitment rules provided by the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for Para Pump Operator?
faq.answer: Candidates need Matric (10th) with an ITI certificate in Electrician, Wireman, Diesel Mechanic, Pump Mechanic, Motor Mechanic, or Pump Operation and Maintenance.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Multipurpose Worker?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Multipurpose Worker post will receive a monthly salary of ₹6,000 as per the guidelines of the Vibhag.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application form directly from the official website at https://jsv.hp.nic.in or through the provided links.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on eligibility, followed by a skill test, physical test, and subsequent document evaluation by the authority.
